subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: "Where do you like to go?" said the ticket officer. "To Rajshahi." said the lady. "How many tickets do you need to buy and of which class?" "Three first class tickets." "Here are the tickets and they will cost you three thousand taka."
guide_solution: The ticket officer asked the lady where she liked to go. In reply the lady said that she would like to go to Rajshahi. The ticket officer then asked her how many tickets she needed and of which class. The lady replied that she needed three first class tickets. The officer gave her the tickets and said that they would cost three thousand taka.
